title: 555. Non-decreasing Subsequences

examples.explanation: All eight distinct non-decreasing groups with length at least two.
Only the leading equal pair is non-decreasing.

hints: Backtrack over positions, extending the current path only with values at least as large as its last element.
At each recursion depth skip a value already tried at that depth to avoid duplicate groups.
Add a copy of the path to the answer whenever its length reaches two or more.
